about: I'm Gonna Do It Even Harder is a two-panel screenshot from The Office. In the top panel Pam Beesly, leaning forward with her mouth open, snaps "Stop ___" at someone off screen. In the bottom panel Michael Scott glares back, jaw set and eyes narrowed, answering "You know what? I'm gonna ___ even harder." The subtitles are blurred out so you can write both lines. It is the format for petty defiance: being told to quit something and doubling down out of pure spite.
usage:
The first box, near the bottom of Pam's panel, is the request: "STOP" followed by the habit. The second box, at the bottom of Michael's panel, is the spiteful reply, ending with "even harder".

It suits any bad habit you are proud of: doomscrolling, buying games you will never play, eating cereal for dinner, refusing to update an app. The fun is in the repetition, so reuse the same verb in both lines.
ideas: I'M GONNA BUY THEM EVEN HARDER
I'M GONNA USE IT EVEN HARDER
I'M GONNA SKIP IT EVEN HARDER
I'M GONNA SAY IT EVEN HARDER
aka: I'm Gonna Do It Even Harder Office
